messages:
Marta: opened a docs PR to tighten private installer cert-chain guidance for air-gapped/VPC installs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6182

Alex: on it. should we call out differences between /etc/ssl/certs and /opt/redwood/certs for RPM vs DEB? some customers stash CA bundles elsewhere.

Marta: added a recommendation: runtime certs under /opt/redwood/certs plus a systemd drop-in to set SSL_CERT_DIR. also a Debian note to run update-ca-certificates.

Sam: paste the systemd snippet so infra can check for unit conflicts.

Marta: snippet:

```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood.service.d/override.conf
[Service]
Environment=SSL_CERT_DIR=/opt/redwood/certs
Restart=on-failure
```

Sam: good. add ordering note with tmpfiles.d and remind to run systemctl daemon-reload after deploying the drop-in.

Li: security: do NOT put private keys in world-readable dirs. recommend chown redwood:redwood and chmod 750 on /opt/redwood/certs. for PKCS#11 use absolute .so paths in installer config (avoid ldconfig-only lookups).

Marta: added permissions snippet and SELinux fcontext examples for RHEL9. included explicit PKCS#11 guidance.

Alex: vendor PKCS#11 link 404ed in the PR (was https://vendor.example.com/pkcs11-guide). can we use the canonical ABI path?

Marta: replaced with two fallbacks: https://docs.redwood.com/vendor/hsm/pkcs11-abi (internal proxy) and the canonical vendor URL, plus text: "If inaccessible, request the ABI/module path from your HSM vendor or SE."

deploy-bot: docs build started for PR #6182 — lint/link-check

deploy-bot: link-check: 1 failure (docs.redwood internal proxy) at docs/priv-vpc/install.md: line 304

Marta: updated to keep both links and added a short vendor-contact fallback to avoid CI flakiness. repushed.

deploy-bot: docs build started for PR #6182 — lint/link-check

deploy-bot: all checks passed ✅

Jen: please add a short migration checklist for customers moving from v1 to v2 installer; we had a support case where certs remained in /etc/ssl and PKCS#11 path was relative.

Marta: added migration steps: 1) copy certs to /opt/redwood/certs 2) chown/chmod (redwood:redwood, 750) 3) set kms.pkcs11.module_path to absolute vendor .so 4) systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart redwood

Alex: add quick sanity-check command customers can run as the service user:

```
# verify TLS and that certs are loadable by service account
sudo -u redwood curl --cacert /opt/redwood/certs/root.pem https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz
```

Marta: added that and noted SELinux boolean tips and Debian `update-ca-certificates --fresh`.

Sam: docs nit — k8s example references a redwood.certs secret but doesn't show mounting as a dir. can you add a compact secret + mount snippet for on-prem clusters?

Marta: added snippet:

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: redwood-certs
type: Opaque
stringData:
  root.pem: |-
    -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
    ...
    -----END CERTIFICATE-----
---
# Mount in pod spec:
volumeMounts:
- name: certs
  mountPath: /opt/redwood/certs
volumes:
- name: certs
  secret:
    secretName: redwood-certs
```

Li: security ack after wording tweak: change "avoid" to "Do not place private keys or customer secrets in world-readable locations."

Marta: updated wording to stronger phrasing and added small troubleshooting FAQ: "If healthcheck fails with TLS errors, verify cert chain order, file permissions, SELinux contexts, and PKCS#11 module path."

Jen: can we cherry-pick to v1-maintenance after merge? solutions-eng needs a heads up.

Marta: yes — merging now and will cherry-pick, then ping solutions-eng channel with a short note and release-docs entry. thanks everyone ❤️
